title: Helios Console – What's New Configuration
description: Controls the 'What's New' screen shown after login. When this payload is present, the sheet is displayed once per unique version string. Remove the payload entirely to disable the feature.

version.description: Version identifier that controls when the sheet appears. The sheet shows once per unique value. Typically matches CFBundleShortVersionString (e.g. '0.3.1') but can be any string — use '0.3.1-hotfix2' to re-show after a config update within the same app version.

headline.description: Main heading displayed at the top of the sheet. Defaults to 'What's New' if omitted.

items.description: List of feature/change entries. At least one item is required. Items are displayed in array order.

icon.description: SF Symbol name for the feature icon. See https://developer.apple.com/sf-symbols/

iconColor.description: Color name for the icon circle. Supported values: blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, pink, cyan, teal, indigo, mint, brown, gray. Defaults to 'blue' if omitted.

title.description: Bold title for this feature entry.

description.description: Supporting description text shown below the title.
examples: Screen share confirmations now automatically disappear after 5 seconds.

dismissButtonTitle.description: Label for the dismiss button at the bottom. Defaults to 'Continue' if omitted.
